title: What Everyone Will Do
label: ch:sa-what-everyone-will-do
canDo: I can say what anyone will do, in every person and number (kariṣyāmi, kariṣyati, kariṣyanti), with each verb's own future stem (paṭhiṣyati, drakṣyati, dāsyati).

payoff.summary: Complete SA-R275-what-everyone-will-do: say what you, your friends and everyone else will do.
